# PokéChamp

> Competitive Pokémon team builder, showcase, and meta analytics platform for championship-format battles.

## Pages

- [Team Builder](https://pokechamp-tau.vercel.app/): Build competitive Pokémon teams with full moveset, item, nature, ability, and stat point configuration. Includes defensive type coverage analysis.
- [Team Showcase](https://pokechamp-tau.vercel.app/team-showcase): Browse, share, and discuss community-submitted competitive Pokémon teams. Features upvoting and threaded discussion.
- [Meta Analytics](https://pokechamp-tau.vercel.app/analytics): Championship meta data with usage tiers, top movesets, held items, abilities, natures, stat point spreads, common teammates, and win/loss matchup analysis for 262 competitive Pokémon.

## Features

- Full 6-slot team builder with drag-and-drop reordering
- Move selection from championship-legal move pools with type, category, power, accuracy, and PP
- Nature selection with +10%/-10% stat modifier previews
- Held item selector with item descriptions and sprites
- Ability selector with full ability descriptions
- Stat Point (SP) allocation engine with Level 50 stat calculator
- Defensive type coverage matrix for full team analysis
- Shared weaknesses and unresisted type warnings
- Team import from Poképaste URLs or raw Showdown format text
- Team export to Poképaste
- Cloud save with shareable team links
- Community team showcase with hearts (upvotes) and threaded discussion
- Championship meta analytics: ranked Pokémon usage, top moves, items, abilities, natures, SP spreads
- Matchup data: common teammates, consistently beats, often loses to
- Winning blows and fatal flaws move analysis

## Technical Details

- Built with React 19, TypeScript, Vite, and TailwindCSS
- Backend: Supabase (PostgreSQL with real-time subscriptions)
- Deployed on Vercel
- 262 competitive Pokémon from the championship Pokédex
- 166 held items, 18 type icons, move category icons
- All Pokémon sprites in WebP format
